services.name: Exterior Detailing
services.description: Foam bath, iron and tar decontamination, hand dry and a protective finish — paint, wheels and glass brought back to a show-ready shine. Pairs with any package.

services.name: Interior Detailing
services.description: Leather, vinyl and wood cleaned and conditioned, carpets extracted, switchgear detailed by hand — on its own or bundled into a package.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.description: Machine polishing to reduce swirl marks, light scratches and oxidation, ahead of a sealant or coating.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.description: A multi-year standalone coating — distinct from the six-month ceramic sealant included in the Full Detail package.

services.name: Glass Treatment
services.description: Hydrophobic polish on every pane. Rain leaves on its own; night glare drops off.

services.name: Maintenance Plans
services.description: Weekly, biweekly, monthly and seasonal plans — choose the rhythm that fits how you drive.

addOns.note: The base price does not include the cleaning of food scraps, excessive dirt, stains or pet hair. These services require an additional budget depending on the condition of the vehicle.
